issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing internal_calc as a private helper (not exported), but the solution assembly file declares 'global internal_calc', exporting the helper. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and may confuse students about whether internal_calc should be accessible externally.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the problem statement by removing the 'global internal_calc' directive from helloWorld.asm in the solution repository so that internal_calc is defined as a private (non-exported) label. Alternatively, if exporting internal_calc was intended, update the problem statement to explicitly allow or require internal_calc to be global.
